personality.description: This person tends to explore new ideas eagerly while still organizing thoughts and tasks with careful precision. In daily habits, they often make detailed plans, check their work thoroughly, and look for creative improvements without losing sight of practical limits. When faced with moral dilemmas, they usually try to understand everyone’s perspective, weigh consequences thoughtfully, and choose the option that protects fairness and harmony, even if it requires personal compromise. In group discussions, they speak clearly and thoughtfully, listen closely to others, and contribute balanced ideas in a calm, cooperative way. They can feel tension under pressure at times, but generally regain composure and keep the conversation constructive.
